sources.title: RFC 8200: Internet Protocol, Version 6 (IPv6) Specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Path MTU Discovery：黑洞與 MSS 邊界
related.titleEn: Path MTU Discovery: black holes and MSS boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受封包總長不超過1280 B且非末片資料對齊；保留來源分片的前提。 交接時須能核對：交付 header-budget.csv 與來源分片決策圖，說明路由器不得代做分片。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept total length at most1280 B with aligned nonfinal payloads, retaining the source-fragmentation assumption. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver header-budget.csv and a source-fragmentation decision diagram showing why routers cannot perform it.
related.difference: 建立探測大小、DF、回報MTU、確認序號四欄表，分開記錄MSS與路徑MTU。
related.differenceEn: Record probe size, DF, reported MTU and acknowledgement sequence; distinguish MSS from path MTU.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
IPv6 路由器不替來源分片；Fragment 表頭與其他延伸表頭都消耗路徑 MTU。
教學基準：floor((1280-40-8-24)/8)*8 = 1208 B；對照：floor((1280-40-8-48)/8)*8 = 1184 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

IPv4 PMTUD 利用不可分片封包及 ICMP 回報縮小路徑尺寸；TCP資料還須扣除兩層表頭。
教學基準：1500-20-20 = 1460 B；對照：1400-20-20 = 1360 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
IPv6 routers do not fragment for a source; Fragment and other extension headers consume the path MTU.
Teaching baseline: floor((1280-40-8-24)/8)*8 = 1208 B; comparison: floor((1280-40-8-48)/8)*8 = 1184 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

IPv4 PMTUD reduces path size using do-not-fragment packets and ICMP feedback; TCP payload also excludes both headers.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-20 = 1460 B; comparison: 1400-20-20 = 1360 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: IPv6 over Ethernet: wire rate and payload efficiency

related.difference: 建立每層位元組預算，明確把IPv6 payload當分子而非應用payload。
related.differenceEn: Build a per-layer byte ledger using IPv6 payload, not application payload, as the numerator.
